items.source:
Resolve ${...} placeholders in the given text, replacing them with corresponding
servlet context init parameter or system property values.
items.translation: 解析给定文本中的 `${...}` 占位符，将其替换为相应的 Servlet 上下文初始化参数或系统属性值。

items.source: servletContext - the servletContext to use for lookups.

A text may contain ${...} placeholders, to be resolved as servlet context init parameters or system properties: for example, ${user.dir}. Default values can be supplied using the ":" separator between key and value.
items.translation: 文本可以包含 `${...}` 占位符，用于解析为 Servlet 上下文初始化参数或系统属性：例如，`${user.dir}`。可以使用键和值之间的":"分隔符提供默认值。

items.source:
Resolve ${...} placeholders in the given text, replacing them with corresponding
servlet context init parameter or system property values. Unresolvable placeholders
with no default value are ignored and passed through unchanged if the flag is set to true.
items.translation: 解析给定文本中的 `${...}` 占位符，将其替换为相应的 Servlet 上下文初始化参数或系统属性值。如果未设置默认值且无法解析的占位符存在，并且标志设置为 true，则忽略该占位符并原样传递。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if there is an unresolvable placeholder and the flag is false
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果存在无法解析的占位符且标志为 false

items.source: ignoreUnresolvablePlaceholders - flag to determine is unresolved placeholders are ignored
items.translation: ignoreUnresolvablePlaceholders - 标志，用于确定是否忽略未解析的占位符。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if there is an unresolvable placeholder
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果存在无法解析的占位符
